allowed_deferred_named_owner.name: Product Onboarding
allowed_deferred_named_owner.route: #/mgr/onboarding (named-owner shell); insertion listed on its domain page
allowed_deferred_named_owner.insertion: First-run flow uses the same provider, account, connection, and installation records as Settings; no duplicate secret store; no SQLite.
allowed_deferred_named_owner.returnContract: Completed setup returns to the Providers manager with the new connection selected and a continuation receipt for any interrupted step.

allowed_deferred_named_owner.name: Installation / Deployment
allowed_deferred_named_owner.route: #/mgr/installation (named-owner shell); insertion listed on its domain page
allowed_deferred_named_owner.insertion: Explicit user-triggered install from the official source for the exact Host/Environment, with verification and rollback inside the provider card.
allowed_deferred_named_owner.returnContract: Install receipts deep-link back to the provider's installation section; a failed verification returns with the previous generation restored.

allowed_deferred_named_owner.name: Server Claim / Bootstrap
allowed_deferred_named_owner.route: #/mgr/server-claim (named-owner shell); insertion listed on its domain page
allowed_deferred_named_owner.insertion: Claim handshake that binds a server record to this Puppet Master install before any hosted work is offered.
allowed_deferred_named_owner.returnContract: A successful claim returns to the Servers card with the claimed server marked connected and a claim receipt.

allowed_deferred_named_owner.name: Servers / Execution Hosts / Clients
allowed_deferred_named_owner.route: #/mgr/servers (named-owner shell); insertion listed on its domain page
allowed_deferred_named_owner.insertion: Manager grammar reserved under System & Advanced; human-language cards only; deep-link slot reserved for the server shell.
allowed_deferred_named_owner.returnContract: Server cards deep-link back into Settings at the matching storage or hosting row with full capability state.

allowed_deferred_named_owner.name: Project Hosting & Files
allowed_deferred_named_owner.route: #/mgr/hosting (named-owner shell); insertion listed on its domain page
allowed_deferred_named_owner.insertion: Source Location card (Hosted On, Project Files, Run Work) plus Project Sync status slots.
allowed_deferred_named_owner.returnContract: Hosting changes return to the Project Hosting card with sync status and a move receipt.

allowed_deferred_named_owner.name: Remote Access
allowed_deferred_named_owner.route: #/mgr/remote-access (named-owner shell); insertion listed on its domain page
allowed_deferred_named_owner.insertion: Pairing and session approvals; protected auth browsing sessions remain human-only.
allowed_deferred_named_owner.returnContract: Approvals return to the Remote Access card with the session list updated; no Settings state is invented here.

allowed_deferred_named_owner.name: Project Sync / Move
allowed_deferred_named_owner.route: #/mgr/sync-move (named-owner shell); insertion listed on its domain page
allowed_deferred_named_owner.insertion: Project relocation and sync bundles owned by the sync pipeline; Settings only surfaces status and entry points.
allowed_deferred_named_owner.returnContract: A finished move returns to Settings Lifecycle with the relocated project's settings re-verified and conflicts, if any, queued for review.

allowed_deferred_named_owner.name: Puppet Master application/content updates
allowed_deferred_named_owner.route: #/mgr/updates (named-owner shell); insertion listed on its domain page
allowed_deferred_named_owner.insertion: Host-scoped signed Puppet Master updates, separate from provider, source-control, language-server, and container tool updates.
allowed_deferred_named_owner.returnContract: Update status cards deep-link into the Updates manager with signed-build receipts.

allowed_deferred_named_owner.name: Full Server backup owner flow
allowed_deferred_named_owner.route: #/mgr/server-backup (named-owner shell); insertion listed on its domain page
allowed_deferred_named_owner.insertion: Full Server backup class alongside settings backup and project backup, with its own schedule and verification.
allowed_deferred_named_owner.returnContract: Backup runs return to the Backup manager's server class with verification receipts and the last-run state.
